Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified Archduchess Maria Theresa of Austria as Dolores's paternal grandmother. All reliable information previously gathered indicated that the correct paternal grandmother was Princess Maria Immaculata of Bourbon-Two Sicilies. The error stems from misunderstanding of the lineage and misinterpretation of genealogical data, possibly due to poor synthesis of information from multiple agents or failure to verify against earlier established facts.
